amendment: RQ5-M: unload every resident model before measuring the next
type: implementation bug fix in a frozen script (second deviation, recorded before the re-run)
frozen_definition: rq5_rq6.json RQ5-M: per-model cold load and peak Ollama-tree working set; models unloaded between conditions
bug: Before each model the script unloaded only that model. Models measured earlier (keep_alive 10 min), or loaded outside the run, stayed resident, so each per-model peak could include other models' runners and the cold load could include eviction work.
evidence: Run 2 peaks 4,563 / 2,142 / 848 MB (3b / 1b / qwen). Measured in isolation (all models unloaded, /api/ps empty, 3 RQ5 prompts): 2,552 / 1,555 / 572 MB, matching /api/ps sizes 2,449 / 1,453 / 464 MB at context 4,096.
fix: New unload_all(): unload every model listed by /api/ps and wait until it is empty, before each model. Nothing else changed.
run_2: Kept as artifacts/rq5_resource_profile/summary_run2_contaminated_memory.json; its memory and cold-load figures are superseded. Stability counts are expected to be unaffected.
outcome_independence: RQ5-M is descriptive (no decision rule). The fix was prompted by a smoke-test memory figure inconsistent with RQ5-M, not by any model comparison.
also_affects: rq5ext_llm_candidates.py (not yet registered or run) now calls the same unload_all().
